description.value: A family-oriented bicycle shop operating since 1959, Russ Hay's is a full-service Specialized dealer in Sidney's downtown core with locations also in Victoria. They offer professional bike fitting by certified specialists alongside a full repair shop, making them a reliable stop for touring cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula. The shop stocks a broad range of parts, accessories, and cycling clothing.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a long-established (since 1959) full-service bicycle shop in Sidney, BC with dedicated service & repair pages and bike fitting. The service page explicitly states they accommodate walk-ins and offer repair from minor adjustments to major overhauls, supporting the urgent-mechanicals criterion. The website address is '2426A Bevan Ave.' while OSM has '2426 Bevan Avenue' — a minor unit-number discrepancy. OSM has no phone; the website lists (250) 656-1512. E-bikes are sold but no explicit e-bike servicing is mentioned.
